purpose: Open-source interoperability fabric for media, dataflow, digital-twin, messaging and 3D systems.
principle: Integrate interoperable open software; do not copy proprietary implementations or bypass attribution, licensing, security or provenance controls.

components.role: managed data routing, transformation, mediation and provenance
JSON-based digital-twin model and policy-controlled connectivity
low-latency pub/sub, request/reply and streaming transport
interoperable composition and interchange for complex 3D scenes

integration_rules: Each external component is pinned and license-verified before activation.
No proprietary product is cloned from protected source code, binaries, credentials or private data.
Open-source code remains subject to its upstream license, notices and attribution requirements.
Unknown or unverified releases remain untrusted.
A component may be replaced when a verified alternative scores better on security, quality, performance, compatibility, maintenance and license suitability.
Trusted Corpus and scholarly source material are never mutated by interoperability automation.
